Yeh guide original VoiceAI spec ka zero-cost version hai. Sabhi paid APIs ke free/open-source alternatives use kiye gaye hain. Developer ko sirf is guide ko follow karna hai — koi confusion nahi, koi extra research nahi.

Original documentation mein sabhi services paid thi. Startup phase mein ye feasible nahi hai. Is guide mein hum puri voice pipeline free tools se build karenge — aur quality mein koi major compromise nahi hogi.
Original stack: ₹8,000–₹20,000+/month. Jugaad stack: ₹0–₹500/month. Jab pehla paying client aaye tab gradually paid services pe migrate karo.
Is guide ki approach hai: pehle launch karo, phir scale karo. Free tools production-ready hain early stage ke liye.

Speech-to-text ke liye hum Whisper.cpp use karenge jo OpenAI ke Whisper model ka C++ port hai. Completely free, local, aur Hindi support achha hai.
medium model recommended hai Hindi ke liye. small model bhi chalega (faster) but accuracy thodi kam hogi.
Yeh ek HTTP server chalata hai port 8081 pe. STT service isko call karegi.
Bhashini Government of India ka free language API hai. Registration karo bhashini.gov.in pe. Approval 24–48 hours mein milti hai.
Hindi STT accuracy 80%+ ke liye audio 16kHz mono WAV format mein hona chahiye. Exotel/Twilio se audio aate waqt ffmpeg se convert karo: ffmpeg -i input.mp3 -ar 16000 -ac 1 output.wav
LLM ke liye Ollama use karenge — ek local model runner jo Llama, Gemma, Mistral aur doosre models ko locally chalata hai. Zero API cost, full privacy.
